modelAssumptions: Treat the two-model-year gap as a 24-month prospective planning analogy, not observed remaining service life.
Assume later age, condition and market resemble the older advertised group. This is a conditional hypothesis, not a measured age effect, residual forecast or statistically calibrated curve.
Use net market values for a reference taxable enterprise. No actual purchase, sale, VAT settlement or VAT-recovery cash flow is modeled.
Keep both unresolved 2019 tax-price bases as independent alternatives; do not select a midpoint or call either an observed tax treatment.
Cash scenario is debt-free by definition. Financed box capital remains unknown; neither tractor credit offers nor US residual coefficients are transferred.
One physical box, charged once in its shared resource; seller stock counts are not fleet quantities. Equity required return is separate and unresolved.
